title: Surreal Cosmic Dreamscape
description: A surreal night scene featuring a giant glowing woman's face enclosed in a transparent bubble above a grassy field. In the foreground, two mice and a small lantern sit near flowers while a large black monster with glowing white eyes and sharp teeth lurks to the right. The sky contains multiple planets, crescent moons, a pink slime-like creature on a green platform, and a dark mountain range under a purple and orange nebula.
prompt: Surreal fantasy landscape at night with a giant translucent bubble containing a woman's glowing pink face floating above a grassy field. In the foreground, a large brown mouse and a small mouse with a lantern stand near flowers, while a black shadowy monster with glowing eyes and sharp teeth watches from the right. The dramatic sky features multiple planets, crescent moons, a large pink amorphous slime creature on a green platform, and dark mountains under a vibrant purple, pink and orange nebula.
